name: kavach-monitoring
description: Cloudflare Worker that receives the Kavach server's structured logs.
comment: No runtime dependencies. The Worker uses only the platform's own APIs — D1 through a binding, fetch, and the Web Crypto-free constant-time compare it writes itself. `wrangler` and `miniflare` are dev-only: one to deploy, one to run the integration tests against the real Workers runtime.
